title: Procurement evaluation: streamlined vendor onboarding flow & SOC2 evidence bundle
creator: Meera Patel
description:
Summary: Build a scalable procurement/vendor onboarding flow that bundles the SOC2 evidence package, vendor portal artifacts, and insurance certs into a single deliverable for enterprise prospects. This work will reduce time-to-contract and unblocking time for Sales by 40% for mid-market and enterprise deals while keeping legal risk controls intact.

Goals:
- Create an internally authoritative SOC2 evidence bundle (report, bridge letter, system description, encryption attestation) that can be delivered via self-serve portal or emailed to prospects.
- Define a two-track onboarding flow: Track A (self-serve: packaged artifacts + automated gating) and Track B (assisted: Sales + Legal intake).
- Run a split experiment to measure conversion lift and time-to-sign for pricing/packaging experiments: bundling security materials with Dedicated/Private proposals vs. standard hosted SKUs.
- Produce a repeatable intake checklist and a vendor-portal integration plan to host artifacts behind SSO for customers who require continuous access.

Scope:
- Author canonical SOC2 bundle and storage location (S3 + signed URLs).
- Update procurement materials and Sales playbook to reference the bundle and the two-track flow.
- Implement a minimal vendor portal endpoint (read-only links) and drift detection alerts when evidence is updated.
- Coordinate with Legal to finalize the wording for what we consider "current evidence" and a process for bridge letters.

Out of scope for this ticket: automating supplier insurance verification with third-party broker and full portal SSO for on-prem customers (will be follow-on ticket).

Constraints & trade-offs:
- Speed vs. legal coverage: we'll prioritize a conservative SOC2 bundle (Type II last 12 months) to maximize acceptance, which increases manual review time at first.
- Self-serve vs. assisted: self-serve decreases cycle time but risks incomplete nuance handling for regulated customers; we'll gate high-sensitivity customers to the assisted track.
- Storage & access: signed URLs are fastest to implement; a fully managed customer-facing SSO portal is higher effort and will be staged as V2.

Success metrics:
- Primary: reduce average procurement time (MQL -> contract executed) for enterprise deals by 30% within 90 days of rollout.
- Secondary: increase conversion rate for Dedicated/Private pricing proposals by 8% in the experiment cohort.
- Operational: <5% of delivered bundles flagged by Legal for missing/invalid docs after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SOC2 evidence bundle created and stored in secure S3 path with access policy
Self-serve artifact delivery flow implemented in Sales portal (links + email template)
Playbook update (Sales + Customer Success) published with gating rules for high-sensitivity customers
Two-track experiment plan documented and instrumentation in analytics dashboard (time-to-sign, conversion rates)
Legal sign-off on bundle contents and bridge-letter template obtained
